sources.entry: GoogleDriveSync - A menu bar app for seamless Google Drive syncing. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/saihgupr/GoogleDriveSync)

summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app that syncs local folders to Google Drive accounts, using rclone for transfers.
summary.what_it_does: GoogleDriveSync lives in the macOS menu bar and syncs local folders to any path on one or more Google Drive accounts. Each folder can be mapped to a different account and destination folder on Drive. Syncing is powered by rclone, with automatic intervals from 15 minutes to daily, or manual "Sync All" and per-folder "Sync Now" options. The menu bar shows live progress, transfer speeds, file counts, and error reports. Exclusion rules use rclone filter patterns, with examples such as node_modules/** and *.tmp. The app checks for updates on launch and detects when macOS remounts external volumes under a new name.
use_cases: back up local folders to Google Drive
sync work and personal Google accounts separately
keep a Mac folder mirrored to a Drive path
sync files from external drives that get renamed on remount
exclude node_modules, temp, or log files from Drive backups
how_to_run: Option 1: Download the release for Apple Silicon or Intel from the Releases page and launch it.
If macOS reports the app as damaged, run: xattr -cr /Applications/GoogleDriveSync.app
notable: Menu bar app with live sync progress, transfer speeds, and file counts
Multiple Google Drive accounts, each folder can target a different account
Handles macOS volume remounts (for example /Volumes/Drive to /Volumes/Drive-1)
Ignore patterns loosely based on .gitignore syntax, via rclone filters
Native builds for Apple Silicon and Intel
caveats: Not signed or notarized by Apple, so Gatekeeper warnings and a manual override are needed on first launch
Google account authorization uses a terminal-based flow
